newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates stay high in tight market.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates stay high in tight market.

text.p: Pakistan overnight rates remained high on Monday with liquidity tight and the money market closed short, dealers said.

Rates opened at 19.50 percent and closed at 20 percent after a tug-of-war between lenders and borrowers, a dealer at KASB & Co said. Most overnights were traded at 17 to 19.5 percent, with rates touching 20 percent at the close.
Central bank extended its discounting facility to some banks for moderate amounts, the dealer said.
